newsitem.title: USA: Digital Biometrics to explore alternatives.
newsitem.headline: Digital Biometrics to explore alternatives.

text.p: Digital Biometrics Inc, a maker of fingerprint identification and gaming products, said Wednesday it hired the investment banking firm of Greene Holcomb & Lannin to advise the company regarding various strategic alternatives.

Those alternatives include joint ventures, technology licensing, acquisition of other businesses or product lines, recapitalization and sale of all or a portion of the company's assets or businesses, Digital said.

"We look forward to having GH&L as a resource as we explore and respond to opportunities which are presenting themselves that have the potential to enhance shareholder value," said chief executive James Granger.
He said, "With the assistance of GH&L we will be exploring a broad range of alternatives for relationships with larger companies who are committed to the biometric industry and/or the gaming market."
